{{Quote|I suppose one can never have too many lab rats.|Dr. Vindi|audio=NuvoVindi1.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
'''Nuvo Vindi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Faust/Legends|Faust]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] from [[Adana/Legends|Adana]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Vindi was mentally unstable, using his talents as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and researcher to achieve his vision of a perfect [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Originally employed as the senior [[Medic/Legends|medic]] for the criminal [[Perma families/Legends|Perma families]], Vindi went missing in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and was believed [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Reappearing on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] scientist during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he became obsessed with recreating the eradicated [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], a deadly water-borne plague which resulted in instantaneous death and had no known cure. Vindi worked out of a subterranean [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in Naboo's [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]] alongside Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[LEP-86C8/Legends|LEP-86C8]], a [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Vindi was not only able to re-engineer the virus, but also create an airborne strain he planned to release in key Republic [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

After several of his battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were discovered by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], Vindi's plot was revealed to Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who then contacted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for assistance. Vindi captured Amidala and Binks before the arrival of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and held them hostage in his [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] until it was [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|attacked]] shortly after by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. After [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] Amidala and Binks for a short time, Vindi attempted to escape Naboo and reintroduce the virus to the galaxy. He was instead apprehended by Skywalker and Kenobi outside his laboratory and was transported to Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Although the virus was released during the battle, a [[Reeksa/Legends|cure]] was [[Mission to Iego/Legends|quickly found]] by Kenobi and Skywalker on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], negating the threat. Vindi was then taken to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for trial.

==Biography==
===Criminal activity===
{{Quote|Doctor Nuvo Vindi, the senior medic for the Perma families. He disappeared ten years ago.|Gregar Typho|audio=DrNuvoVindiSeniorMedic-BSV.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
[[File:NuvoVindislaboratory.png|thumb|left|290px|Dr. Vindi examines his stockpile of the Blue Shadow Virus.]]
Nuvo Vindi was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Faust/Legends|Faust]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adana/Legends|Adana]].<ref name="SW:CW CCE" /> Although he was regarded as a brilliant [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Vindi had a history of mental illness that manifested itself in an unorthodox philosophy that held [[virus]]es to be the highest form of life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Of the viruses Vindi considered sacred, the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] held a particular interest for him. Responsible for the ancient [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] which resurfaced around [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]] and depopulated [[Candoria]] and its colonies, the Blue Shadow Virus was lethal to all known [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] enacted strict quarantines that contained the Blue Shadow Virus on affected worlds, preventing it from spreading until it eventually died out.<ref name="VisBattles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> Vindi took the eradication of the virus to be tantamount to genocide and eventually became determined to recreate it.<ref name="BSV" />

During Vindi's career, a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on him, eventually resulting in him ending up on the Republic's Most Wanted list. The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after the bounty on his head increased to 250,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], he gassed all of the bounty-posting agencies on the planet [[Ord Marsax]], then led dozens of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on a wild chase.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

At some point, the doctor lent his talents to the operations of a criminal organization known as the [[Perma families/Legends|Perma families]]. Vindi gained infamy as the senior [[Medic/Legends|medic]] and [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] for the families, operating out of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Perma]].<ref name="VisBattles" /> Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he reportedly went missing,<ref name="BSV" /> believed to have been disposed of by the Perma families themselves. The doctor was in fact alive and well,<ref name="VisBattles" /> and by the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|117}}</ref> he was associated with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Confederates, hoping to use Vindi's unusual intellect in their war against the Republic, promised Vindi that they would aid him in bringing forth an era in which viruses dominated the galaxy.<ref name="VisBattles" />

The Confederacy assigned Vindi to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where he was given a [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|subterranean laboratory]] that had been built by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[32 BBY/Legends|ten years prior]]. Trade Federation [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] remained bitter toward Naboo after his failed [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet and so sponsored Vindi's and usage of the lab beneath the planet's [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]].<ref name="VisBattles" /> With the help of the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]],<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> the doctor worked to recreate the Blue Shadow Virus to be unleashed against the Republic. Assisted in his work by a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and the [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] [[LEP-86C8/Legends|LEP-86C8]],<ref name="VisBattles" /> Vindi was able to recreate the Blue Shadow Virus in its original, water-borne strain which was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] its victims almost instantly. He then began work on engineering an airborne strain of the virus that was to be stored in vials that could then be loaded into [[Viral bomb/Legends|bombs]] and sent to key Republic [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] throughout the galaxy.<ref name="BSV" />

===Reappearance===
{{Quote|What's a life-form like you doing in a swamp like this?|Dr. Vindi, to Padmé Amidala|audio=NuvoVindi2.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
[[File:NuvoHolo.png|thumb|right|250px|Republic forces view a hologram of Vindi explaining his plot.]]
Unbeknownst to the doctor, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] had begun investigating the reappearance of battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on their planet. After being informed by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] herder [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]] that her herd had sensed the presence of droids, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]] dispatched [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to investigate. His team was able to locate and destroy a battle droid scouting party and retrieve an intact [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Nuvo Vindi)|tactical droid]].<ref name="The Valley">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valley]]''</ref> Due to the appearance of battle droids on the planet, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of Naboo returned to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to aid in the investigation. The two witnessed a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] on the tactical droid, where they learned of the virus, which led the Naboo to contact the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] for assistance. Shortly thereafter, Amidala and Binks began searching for the virus's source in the eastern Gungan swamp lands, as one of the destroyed battle droids was found with a [[Slug-beetle/Legends|slug-beetle]] that was native to the area. Not far from the swamplands, the two ran into Peppi Bow, whose shaak herd had recently been killed by a sample of the Blue Shadow Virus that had escaped into a Naboo [[river]]. Peppi pointed them towards the swamps where the virus might have entered the river, an area heavily monitored by Dr. Vindi's droid forces.<ref name="BSV" />

Vindi discovered and captured Amidala and Binks, but not before the duo were able to report their coordinates back to Captain Typho. Holding the two [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] within his laboratory, Vindi demonstrated his ability to create a new, airborne strain of the Blue Shadow Virus using machinery that generated arcs of electricity.<ref name="BSV" /> Although this new viral strain was more pervasive, it killed its victims over a longer period of time than the ingested, water-borne strain, taking around forty-eight hours to cause death.<ref name="MoaTM">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> Vindi explained his plan for spreading the virus throughout the Republic to his prisoners before readying his final bomb and giving it to LEP-86C8 to store.<ref name="BSV" />

===Releasing the Blue Shadow Virus===
{{Quote|Once the first droid breaks out of that laboratory, all Naboo is doomed!|Dr. Vindi|audio=NuvoVindi3.flac|<ref name="MoaTM" />}}
After being dispatched to Naboo by the Jedi High Council, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], along with Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], arrived in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], and prepared for an assault on Vindi's lab. They had learned of the doctor's identity and his plot to release the virus from a [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] extracted from a destroyed battle droid. Following Tano and Peppi Bow's reconnaissance of the coordinates sent to Captain Typho by Amidala, the three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|breach]] the compound and proceed with their missions: Tano and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] were to take [[Clone trooper/Legends|members]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and provide a distraction for the battle droids, while Kenobi deactivated the bombs. Skywalker was tasked with rescuing Amidala and Binks, in addition to capturing Vindi.<ref name="BSV" />

Alerted to the breach, the doctor ordered his battle droids to combat the intruders while he stayed behind with Amidala and Binks. Preparing for the Jedi's arrival, Vindi tied his two prisoners to the equipment he had used to alter the virus. When Skywalker arrived, the doctor activated his machine, which began to electrically shock his hostages, and ordered the Jedi and his troops to lay down their arms unless they wished to see the Senator and Representative die. Skywalker complied, dropping his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] dropped their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Although Vindi deactivated the machine, he knew he could not stop the Jedi for long, and so he offered Skywalker a choice: capture him, or save the hostages. Vindi began to shock his prisoners once again and escaped with several containers of the virus while Skywalker moved to rescue Amidala and Binks.<ref name="BSV" /> While Vindi ran from the room, he knocked over a rack of vials containing the virus. Before they were able to hit the ground and shatter, Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to grab them.<ref name="VisBattles" />

[[File:Vindihastheruns.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Vindi flees his laboratory during the Republic assault.]]
During Vindi's flight to his [[Vindi's shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in the laboratory's underground [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Vindi remotely activated the timers on his virus bombs. Under the threat of discharging the bombs and releasing the virus throughout the lab, Kenobi's [[Clone ordnance specialist/Legends|clone bomb squad]] worked fervently to deactivate the explosives before their timers ran out. When Vindi reached his landing platform, which promptly began to ascend out of the hangar, Kenobi, Skywalker, and CT-7567 burst through the hangar door and advanced on him. The doctor stalled the three by throwing several vials of the virus at them, forcing Kenobi to catch the containers before they could shatter. Vindi was able to exit his laboratory, but was soon faced with Skywalker, who had managed to climb on top of the platform. While threatening to drop yet another vial, Vindi was tackled by Peppi Bow, who had remained outside the compound during the raid.<ref name="BSV" />

The doctor refused to give up hope, though, and excitedly proclaimed that his bombs were about to go off. However, there was no explosion, as the clone bomb squad had deactivated all but one of them&mdash;which was still in the possession of Vindi's assistant droid. The droid was soon discovered by Senator Amidala, and the bomb was deactivated.<ref name="BSV" />

As Skywalker and Kenobi ushered the captured Dr. Vindi onto his [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for transport to the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he would stand trial for his crimes, the three heard a red alert alarm coming from the laboratory below. To Vindi's delight, his assistant droid had been able to remove the virus container from the last bomb and ran off with it before the bomb had been deactivated. The droid had sneaked back into the bomb storage room and reactivated one of the explosives, destroying himself and two clones in the process. The explosion released the virus throughout the lab and sealed Amidala, Binks, Tano, the clones, and the surviving droids inside. Although Vindi was threatened by Skywalker, who put his lightsaber to the doctor's throat, Vindi refused to aid the Jedi in their search for an antidote, stating it had been his job to create the virus, not to cure it. Vindi was then taken to Theed and imprisoned while the Jedi sought a cure for the virus.<ref name="MoaTM" />

Skywalker and Kenobi learned that the root of the [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] plant of the planet [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] could negate the effects of the virus, and the two were able to [[Mission to Iego/Legends|secure a sample]] before the virus killed all those trapped in the lab or escaped to ravage Naboo. The two Jedi returned to Naboo with reeksa root, and upon the Jedi's return, Vindi was taken to Coruscant for trial.<ref name="MoaTM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Meanwhile, as we speak, thousands and thousands of so-called 'superior' lifeforms are spreading their disease of war throughout the galaxy! Perhaps they are the ones who should be ''eradicated''?|Dr. Vindi|audio=NuvoVindi4.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
[[File:VindiBoasting-BSV.png|thumb|right|290px|Doctor Vindi boasting about his work]]
Nuvo Vindi was a Faust,<ref name="SW:CW CCE" /> a [[blue]]-skinned species with doubled eyelids. Vindi himself had large [[purple]] markings around his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] with a heavy accent.<ref name="BSV" /> He commonly wore a white doctor's coat, as well as Permese glass spectacles and air-tight boots. When the possibility of being exposed to dangerous substances arose, Vindi donned a biohazard hood.<ref name="VisBattles" />

A talented scientist, Vindi had an instinctual understanding of biology and biochemistry. Despite this, the doctor was mentally unstable and believed viruses were the highest form of life in the galaxy. This philosophy disturbed and frightened even the Perma families, and upon Vindi's disappearance, it was believed the families themselves had orchestrated his murder. After its eradication, Vindi became obsessed with the Blue Shadow Virus, which he saw as beautiful. He was adamant in his belief that the Blue Shadow Virus was a life-form that had been murdered and was willing to torture and kill in order to revive it. His plot to release it back into the galaxy would have resulted in countless deaths, and Vindi showed no remorse at the thought. Instead, the doctor was genuinely excited, believing it would bring peace and purity to the universe.<ref name="VisBattles" />

Vindi could be demeaning at times to the droids under his command, yelling at LEP-86C8 following the capture of Amidala and Binks. He also stood undaunted, even with a lightsaber at his throat, after his defeat at the hands of the Jedi.<ref name="BSV" /> The doctor was delighted at the thought of the virus escaping the lab and destroying Naboo, even if it was unable to get off of the planet. Furthermore, he enjoyed the prospect of not only the death of the Jedi, but himself as well.<ref name="MoaTM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Michael York was brought in to voice Doctor Vindi, and he just went crazy. When he says 'Yes, yes yes yes yes,' I think it's pretty funny and it shows this kind of bizarre villain that seemed kind of a little bit crazy as if he's been in the lab too long.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]], on York's performance as Vindi|<ref name="DVD Featurette" />}}
[[File:WantedDr.Vindi.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Doctor Vindi, as depicted in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'']]
Dr. Nuvo Vindi first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]] as the main antagonist of the episode "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]," and once again&mdash;albeit less prominently&mdash;in the following episode, "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]." Vindi was voiced by [[Michael York]] in the television series.<ref name="gg">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode017.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Blue Shadow Virus}}</ref> and by [[James Arnold Taylor]] in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="LEGO SW">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

Vindi's design was based on abandoned character sketches of an alien astronaut from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], given to ''The Clone Wars'' production staff by [[George Lucas]], who specifically requested that Vindi's appearance correspond to the alien. [[Jackson Sze]], normally an environment and landscape artist, designed the final version of the character.<ref name="DVD Featurette">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]&mdash;Featurette 117: Blue Shadow Virus</ref> The director of "Blue Shadow Virus," [[Giancarlo Volpe]], planned for Vindi to look "extra weird," leading to Sze's inclusion of the character's double eyelids. Sze created a series of drawings of Vindi's face on [[September 12]], [[2007]]. Pieces of lightning concept art of Vindi were done by [[Matt Gaser]] and [[Chris Voy]]. For a shot in which Vindi stands in front of lightning, Graser initially wanted to light his face too, but supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] felt that it would be more dramatic to have his face in shadow which would make him "more of a nerdy evil guy".<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> In [[2014]], [[Star Wars Blog|''Star Wars'' Blog]] author [[Kevin Beentjes]] also noted Vindi's resemblance to an alien senator sketch for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Blogaliens">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>

Vindi was also featured in the [[2011]] non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars'', appearing in several cutscenes and featuring prominently in the game's adaptation of "Blue Shadow Virus." The game implies that Vindi is in fact working for the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], causing her much distress when he is captured on Naboo. After Vindi is captured, he is locked in the brig of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], which acts as the in-game hub. Players may later release Vindi from his cell by using a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] character. Doing this makes Vindi available for purchase and use in the Free Play mode of the game.<ref name="LEGO SW" />
